buys.item: Chai from the stall at the Lodhi Road gate

answer.says: The Ring Road is a fine example of civil society's expansion, Mrs. Kapoor. It connects the needs of the city, even if it sometimes chokes on its own volume. I am not stuck; I am merely contemplating the delay. May I offer you a cup of tea? The stall at the gate is still open.
answer.thought: Mrs. Kapoor has misread my absence as a traffic problem, a concrete fact where I was engaged in a spiritual struggle. The distinction is minor to her, but significant to me: I was not moving through space, but through the categories of history. I will accept her hospitality and share a small drink, for sociability is the first form of recognition in the world of work.
